job_description: We are looking for a Data Analyst to analyze business data, build dashboards, identify trends, and communicate insights. Required skills include Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, Excel, Power BI, data analysis, and data visualization. Experience with statistics, data cleaning, and exploratory data analysis is preferred.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and maintain software applications. Required skills include Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, Git, SQL, REST APIs, and problem solving. Experience with software development, databases, version control, and web technologies is preferred.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to develop, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models. Required skills include Python, machine learning, deep learning, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, SQL, and data analysis. Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, model deployment, NLP, and predictive modeling is preferred.

We are looking for an HR Specialist to support recruitment, employee relations, onboarding, benefits administration, training, HR documentation, and workplace policies. Required skills include human resources, recruitment, employee relations, communication, documentation, Microsoft Office, and reporting. Experience with HR operations, payroll, benefits, and employee development is preferred.

We are looking for a Marketing Specialist to plan and execute marketing campaigns, create promotional content, analyze campaign performance, and support brand development. Required skills include marketing, advertising, communication, social media, content creation, presentations, analytics, and project management. Experience with digital marketing, branding, websites, and marketing analytics is preferred.

We are looking for a Financial Analyst to analyze financial data, prepare reports, support budgeting and forecasting, and provide insights for business decisions. Required skills include Excel, financial analysis, accounting, budgeting, reporting, statistics, and data analysis. Experience with SQL, Power BI, dashboards, financial modeling, and business intelligence is preferred.
